title: Nvidia-Backed AI Drugmaker Iambic Raises $150 Million in US IPO
key_facts: Iambic Therapeutics, a startup using AI to find new medicines, raised $150 million in an IPO announced on 14 Oct 2026.
Shares priced at $16 each; trading starts on Nasdaq on Thursday under the ticker IAM.
Private investors had put in $462 million since the 2019 launch.
Its first drug, IAM1363, is a pill for HER2-positive solid tumors and has shown early anti-tumor activity in patients; a registrational trial could begin as soon as 2027, per a filing.
A second cancer drug, IAM217, and a third prospect are in development.
Several AI drug companies have struggled since going public, and some are accused of exaggerating what they can deliver.
Twenty-five biotechs have priced IPOs in 2026.
